TaskPointer.description:
Pointer to content stored in an external backend.

Attributes:
    backend: Opaque storage backend identifier (no business semantics).
    key: Backend-specific addressing key (path, row id, vector id, ...).
    metadata: Optional free-form metadata (content_type, size, ...).

key.description: Backend-specific addressing key (path, row id, vector id, ...).
key.title: Key

metadata.description: Optional free-form metadata (content_type, size, ...). Omitted when None.

TaskPointer.title: TaskPointer

description:
Execution snapshot of a single task node.

Attributes:
    task_id: Task identifier (deterministic-ID convention may apply).
    step: Step name within the task (opaque).
    execution_id: Execution generation identifier. A new execution of the
        same task (resume / rerun) uses a new execution_id, so multiple
        versions of the same node coexist for time-travel queries.
    parent_task_id: Parent task in the recursive lineage (None = root).
    status: Opaque status string (protocol embeds no vocabulary).
    input_pointer / output_pointer: Pointer-ized input/output content.
    error: Error message if the execution failed (opaque text).
    cost: Free-form cost metrics (token usage, USD, ...; business-defined).
    model: Optional model identifier (business-defined).
    created_at / updated_at: Record timestamps.
    expire_at: Absolute expiry instant for the lease term (None = no expiry).

cost.description: Free-form cost metrics (business-defined). Omitted when None.

error.description: Error message if the execution failed (opaque text). Omitted when None.

execution_id.description: Execution generation identity (T11). A new execution of the same task (resume / rerun) uses a new execution_id; multiple generations coexist.
execution_id.title: Execution Id

expire_at.description: Absolute expiry instant for the lease term (T1); readers filter lazily. Omitted when None.

input_pointer.description: Pointer-ized input content (T5); never inline payloads. Omitted when None.

model.description: Optional model identifier (business-defined). Omitted when None.

output_pointer.description: Pointer-ized output content (T5). Omitted when None.

parent_task_id.description: Parent task in the recursive lineage (None = root). Omitted when None.

status.description: Opaque status string (T6); the protocol embeds no vocabulary.
status.title: Status

title: TaskSnapshot
